name: Glow Loop
summary: A phone tab bar where a glowing ring stretches to the tab you tap, then snaps back round
about: A bottom tab bar for phone screens with a ring of warm light around the selected icon. When you pick another tab the ring stretches across the bar like a rubber band, springs back into a circle with a comet-like afterglow and a puff of sparks, and the icon plays its own little reaction. It suits dark-looking mobile apps and also has a soft light version.
how: Tap or click a tab, or use the Left and Right arrow keys (Home and End jump to the ends).
The ring's far edge races to the new tab while the near edge stays, so the light stretches into a long capsule.
The tail catches up with a springy bounce, a soft afterglow drifts behind it and sparks pop where it lands.
Each icon reacts in its own way (the house hops, the compass needle spins, the wallet flips) and the screen cards slide in one after another.
